gh_runner_story: THIS IS THE PATTERN, PRODUCTIZED - a control plane in your own AWS account launches an ephemeral EC2 runner per job and terminates it. Flex mode (per-job spec via runs-on labels) or Fleet mode (Terraform-defined groups). Boot ~1 min base images, 2-3 min full.

There is a FREE non-commercial tier for open source and personal use requiring only an acknowledgement link - loractl is a public personal repo, so the licence cost is plausibly ZERO. Pre-baked AMIs are the cleanest answer to the 20GB cold-start problem.

gh_runner_story: THE first-party reference implementation - AutoscalingRunnerSet CRDs create one EphemeralRunner Pod per queued job and delete it on completion. GPU via the NVIDIA device plugin on a GPU node pool. 6.4k stars, last push 2026-08-03, release gha-runner-scale-set-0.14.2.

notes: Documented pattern for exactly this problem: pin runners to a labelled node group via nodeAffinity so work PVCs land on the same node and the weight cache is reused across jobs - explicitly trading full ephemeral isolation for cache warmth.
